mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.type, p.content, COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT t.name) FILTER (WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS tags FROM problems p LEFT JOIN problem_tags pt ON pt.problem_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM problem_tags fpt JOIN tags ft ON ft.id = fpt.tag_id WHERE fpt.problem_id = p.id AND lower(ft.name) = lower(#{tag})) GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.content, COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT t.name) FILTER (WHERE t.name IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS tags FROM problems p LEFT JOIN problem_tags pt ON pt.problem_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.department_id = #{departmentId} GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY random() LIMIT #{count}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problems (type, content, image_url, reference_text, explanation, blank_reveal_count, status, department_id, source_number, created_by) VALUES (#{type}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{referenceText}, #{explanation}, #{blankRevealCount}, #{status}, #{departmentId}, #{sourceNumber}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE problems SET content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, reference_text = #{referenceText}, explanation = #{explanation}, blank_reveal_count = #{blankRevealCount}, source_number = #{sourceNumber}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE problems SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE problems SET department_id = #{departmentId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM problem_tags fpt JOIN tags ft ON ft.id = fpt.tag_id WHERE fpt.problem_id = p.id AND lower(ft.name) = lower(#{tag}))

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM problems p JOIN departments d ON d.id = p.department_id
